# Space Pilates + Wellness Society

> Boutique mat Pilates and wellness studio in Historic Downtown Sanford, Florida. Four class formats (classical mat Pilates, Sculpt, Strength, restorative Yoga), small classes of up to 15, founded by Carey Caratini, a Pilates instructor, NASM certified personal trainer and licensed mental health therapist.

- Address: 307 E 2nd St, Sanford, FL 32771 (Historic Downtown Sanford)
- Phone: (321) 249-2262
- Email: hi@spacepilatesandwellness.com
- Serves: Sanford, Lake Mary, Heathrow, Longwood
- New member offer: 2 weeks of unlimited classes for $69
- Prices: drop-in $29; 10 class pack $230; memberships $89/month (4 classes), $149/month (8 classes), $199/month (unlimited); month to month, no contract
- Schedule: weekday classes from 6:00 AM to 6:30 PM, plus Saturday and Sunday mornings
- Booking: Mariana Tek, on the website and the Space Pilates & Wellness app (iOS and Android)

## Guides (by Carey Caratini)
- [Benefits of Pilates: A Complete Guide to What It Builds in You](https://spacepilatesandwellness.com/learn/benefits-of-pilates): The benefits of Pilates, explained plainly: core strength, posture, mobility, balance, breathing and focus, and why it suits beginners and older adults.
- [Benefits of Yoga: A Complete Guide to Body, Breath and Mind](https://spacepilatesandwellness.com/learn/benefits-of-yoga): The benefits of yoga explained: flexibility, strength, balance, breath, stress relief, sleep routines and recovery, plus a plain guide to the main yoga styles.
- [Breathwork in Pilates and Yoga: How Each Uses the Breath](https://spacepilatesandwellness.com/learn/breathwork-in-pilates-and-yoga): Breathwork in Pilates and yoga compared: lateral ribcage breathing, ujjayi, the extended exhale, simple drills, and mistakes like holding your breath.
- [How Often Should You Do Pilates? A Weekly Guide by Your Goal](https://spacepilatesandwellness.com/learn/how-often-should-you-do-pilates): How often should you do Pilates? For most people, two to three times a week. Here is how to set your frequency by goal, pair it with other training, and rest.
- [Mat vs Reformer Pilates: The Honest Difference, Explained](https://spacepilatesandwellness.com/learn/mat-vs-reformer-pilates): Mat vs reformer Pilates compared honestly: equipment, how springs assist or resist, difficulty, cost, class size, which suits beginners, and whether to do both.
- [Pilates and Strength Training: Why the Combination Works](https://spacepilatesandwellness.com/learn/pilates-and-strength-training): Why Pilates and strength training work better together: control and alignment plus load, a sample weekly mix, and how a slower, heavier strength class is built.
- [Pilates for Beginners: What to Expect at Your First Class](https://spacepilatesandwellness.com/learn/pilates-for-beginners): New to Pilates? What happens in your first class, how to prepare, the beginner moves explained in plain words, and how to choose a class that fits you.
- [Pilates for Posture: How It Helps You Stand and Sit Taller](https://spacepilatesandwellness.com/learn/pilates-for-posture): Why posture slips with desks, phones and driving, what Pilates trains to support it, simple at-home cues, and when it is time to see a professional instead.
- [Restorative Yoga vs Vinyasa: Pace, Props and Who Each Suits](https://spacepilatesandwellness.com/learn/restorative-yoga-vs-vinyasa): Restorative yoga vs vinyasa: how they differ in pace, intensity, props and holds, who each suits, and how both fit alongside strength training and Pilates.
- [Strength Training for Women: A Calm, Complete Guide to Start](https://spacepilatesandwellness.com/learn/strength-training-for-women): A practical guide to strength training for women: why strength matters at every age, how to start, progressive overload, recovery, and where Pilates fits.
- [What to Wear to Pilates: Clothes, Grippy Socks and What to Bring](https://spacepilatesandwellness.com/learn/what-to-wear-to-pilates): What to wear to Pilates, sculpt, strength and yoga classes: fitted clothes you can move in, why grippy socks matter, hair, what to bring and what to leave home.
- [Yoga for Stress and Sleep: An Evening Wind-Down Routine](https://spacepilatesandwellness.com/learn/yoga-for-stress-and-sleep): How yoga for stress and sleep works: slow movement, calming breathing techniques, a simple evening wind-down routine, and when to seek professional support.
